title: Putting Spec Kit Through Its Paces: Radical Idea or Reinvented Waterfall?
author: Colin Eberhardt
description: Spec-Driven Development promises reliable, specification-led software generation, but in practice I found the workflow slow, heavy, and less effective than iterative prompting. This post walks through a real-world test using Spec Kit and explains why traditional AI-assisted development still outpaces SDD by a wide margin.
